subhero.en: Humira (adalimumab), Skyrizi (risankizumab), Stelara (ustekinumab), and Cosentyx (secukinumab) are the four most-prescribed biologic drugs for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, and their 2026 costs diverge sharply. Humira now competes with more than 10 FDA-approved biosimilars priced as low as $550 per month, Stelara carries a Medicare Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day supply under the Inflation Reduction Act, and Skyrizi and Cosentyx remain patent-protected brand-only biologics with monthly-equivalent list prices above $7,000. This comparison breaks down cash prices, Medicare Part B and Part D treatment, GoodRx and pharmacy pricing, biosimilar competition, and each manufacturer's patient assistance program so you can see where your prescribed biologic falls.
subhero.es: Humira (adalimumab), Skyrizi (risankizumab), Stelara (ustekinumab) y Cosentyx (secukinumab) son los cuatro biologicos mas recetados para psoriasis en placas de moderada a severa, y sus costos de 2026 difieren notablemente. Humira ahora compite con mas de 10 biosimilares aprobados por la FDA con precios desde $550 por mes, Stelara tiene un Precio Justo Maximo de Medicare de $4,695 por suministro de 30 dias bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, y Skyrizi y Cosentyx siguen siendo biologicos de marca protegidos por patente con precios de lista mensuales equivalentes por encima de $7,000. Esta comparacion desglosa los precios en efectivo, el tratamiento de Medicare Parte B y Parte D, los precios de GoodRx y farmacia, la competencia de biosimilares y el programa de asistencia al paciente de cada fabricante.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, monthly-equivalent brand cash prices for the four leading psoriasis biologics range from about $4,000 for Stelara to about $8,750 for Skyrizi without insurance. Humira has the biggest discount opportunity: FDA-approved biosimilars run as low as $550 per month, a 92 percent discount from Humira's $6,922 brand list price. Stelara is the only one of the four selected for Medicare's Inflation Reduction Act price negotiation, with a Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day supply effective January 1, 2026, down 66 percent from its 2023 list price. Skyrizi and Cosentyx have no biosimilar competition as of 2026 and were not selected for IRA negotiation, so their Medicare Part D cost depends entirely on your plan's formulary tier. Each manufacturer runs a separate patient assistance program: AbbVie's myAbbVie Assist (Humira and Skyrizi, roughly 600% of the Federal Poverty Level), Johnson & Johnson's JJPAF (Stelara, roughly 500% FPL), and the Novartis Patient Assistance Foundation (Cosentyx, roughly 500% FPL). All out-of-pocket Part D spending across all four drugs counts toward the same 2026 annual $2,100 cap.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, los precios de marca en efectivo mensuales equivalentes para los cuatro biologicos principales para psoriasis van desde aproximadamente $4,000 para Stelara hasta aproximadamente $8,750 para Skyrizi sin seguro. Humira tiene la mayor oportunidad de descuento: los biosimilares aprobados por la FDA cuestan desde $550 por mes, un descuento del 92 por ciento frente al precio de lista de marca de Humira de $6,922. Stelara es el unico de los cuatro seleccionado para la negociacion de precios de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, con un Precio Justo Maximo de $4,695 por suministro de 30 dias efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026, una reduccion del 66 por ciento respecto a su precio de lista de 2023. Skyrizi y Cosentyx no tienen competencia de biosimilares en 2026 y no fueron seleccionados para negociacion IRA, por lo que su costo de Medicare Parte D depende completamente del nivel del formulario de su plan. Cada fabricante opera un programa de asistencia al paciente separado: myAbbVie Assist de AbbVie (Humira y Skyrizi, aproximadamente 600% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza), JJPAF de Johnson & Johnson (Stelara, aproximadamente 500% FPL) y la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Novartis (Cosentyx, aproximadamente 500% FPL). Todo el gasto de bolsillo de la Parte D entre los cuatro medicamentos cuenta hacia el mismo limite anual de $2,100 de 2026.

callout.en: Of the four psoriasis biologics compared here, only Stelara (ustekinumab) was selected for Medicare's first round of Inflation Reduction Act price negotiation. Starting January 1, 2026, Medicare Part D enrollees pay no more than $4,695 for a 30-day supply of Stelara, a 66 percent reduction from the $13,836 list price that applied in 2023. Humira, Skyrizi, and Cosentyx were not selected for either the first round (effective 2026) or the second round (effective 2027) of IRA negotiation, so no negotiated Maximum Fair Price applies to those three drugs. CMS has confirmed Stelara will exit the negotiated-drug list in 2027 as biosimilar competition drives its market price below the negotiated MFP.
callout.es: De los cuatro biologicos para psoriasis comparados aqui, solo Stelara (ustekinumab) fue seleccionado para la primera ronda de negociacion de precios de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion. A partir del 1 de enero de 2026, los beneficiarios de Medicare Parte D pagan no mas de $4,695 por un suministro de 30 dias de Stelara, una reduccion del 66 por ciento respecto al precio de lista de $13,836 vigente en 2023. Humira, Skyrizi y Cosentyx no fueron seleccionados ni para la primera ronda (efectiva en 2026) ni para la segunda ronda (efectiva en 2027) de negociacion IRA, por lo que ningun Precio Justo Maximo negociado se aplica a esos tres medicamentos.

introParagraphs.en: Humira, Skyrizi, Stelara, and Cosentyx are FDA-approved biologic drugs for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, and three of them also treat psoriatic arthritis. Each blocks a different inflammatory pathway: Humira (adalimumab) blocks tumor necrosis factor (TNF), Skyrizi (risankizumab-rzaa) and Stelara (ustekinumab) block interleukin-23 and interleukin-12/23 respectively, and Cosentyx (secukinumab) blocks interleukin-17A. That mechanism difference does not change how each drug is billed, but the four drugs have sharply different biosimilar status, IRA negotiation status, and manufacturer assistance programs in 2026, which is why comparing them side by side matters more for your wallet than the underlying pathway does. For single-drug detail, see the dedicated pages for [Humira cost](/en/drug/humira-cost), [Skyrizi cost](/en/drug/skyrizi-cost), and [Stelara cost](/en/drug/stelara-cost).
introParagraphs.es: Humira, Skyrizi, Stelara y Cosentyx son medicamentos biologicos aprobados por la FDA para psoriasis en placas de moderada a severa, y tres de ellos tambien tratan la artritis psoriasica. Cada uno bloquea una via inflamatoria diferente: Humira (adalimumab) bloquea el factor de necrosis tumoral (TNF), Skyrizi (risankizumab-rzaa) y Stelara (ustekinumab) bloquean la interleucina-23 y la interleucina-12/23 respectivamente, y Cosentyx (secukinumab) bloquea la interleucina-17A. Esa diferencia de mecanismo no cambia como se factura cada medicamento, pero los cuatro medicamentos tienen un estado de biosimilar, un estado de negociacion IRA y programas de asistencia del fabricante muy diferentes en 2026.

introParagraphs.en: The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, signed August 16, 2022, authorized CMS to negotiate Medicare drug prices directly with manufacturers for the first time. Stelara was one of the first 10 drugs selected for Round 1 negotiation, and its Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day supply took effect January 1, 2026. Humira already faces biosimilar competition that predates the IRA program: patents expired in 2023, and more than 10 FDA-approved biosimilars now compete on price, several priced 85 to 92 percent below Humira's brand list. Skyrizi and Cosentyx remain fully patent-protected with no biosimilar and no IRA negotiation, so their 2026 costs are set entirely by AbbVie and Novartis list pricing and each drug's manufacturer savings programs.
introParagraphs.es: La Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022, firmada el 16 de agosto de 2022, autorizo a CMS a negociar directamente los precios de medicamentos de Medicare con los fabricantes por primera vez. Stelara fue uno de los primeros 10 medicamentos seleccionados para la negociacion de la Ronda 1, y su Precio Justo Maximo de $4,695 por suministro de 30 dias entro en vigor el 1 de enero de 2026. Humira ya enfrenta competencia de biosimilares que precede al programa IRA: las patentes expiraron en 2023, y mas de 10 biosimilares aprobados por la FDA ahora compiten en precio, varios con precios entre 85 y 92 por ciento por debajo de la marca Humira. Skyrizi y Cosentyx siguen totalmente protegidos por patente sin biosimilar ni negociacion IRA.

introParagraphs.en: Patients switching between these four biologics for cost reasons should talk to their dermatologist or rheumatologist first. Dosing schedules differ substantially: Humira is typically injected every other week, Cosentyx monthly, and Skyrizi and Stelara every 12 weeks after an initial loading period. Many commercial and Medicaid formularies now require step therapy, meaning you must try and fail a lower-cost biologic (often biosimilar adalimumab) before the plan approves a costlier one like Skyrizi or Cosentyx. The comparison table below lays out cash price, Medicare treatment, biosimilar availability, and manufacturer patient assistance program for all four drugs side by side.
introParagraphs.es: Los pacientes que cambian entre estos cuatro biologicos por razones de costo deben hablar primero con su dermatologo o reumatologo. Los horarios de dosificacion difieren sustancialmente: Humira generalmente se inyecta cada dos semanas, Cosentyx mensualmente, y Skyrizi y Stelara cada 12 semanas despues de un periodo de carga inicial. Muchos formularios comerciales y de Medicaid ahora requieren terapia escalonada, lo que significa que debe probar y fallar con un biologico de menor costo (a menudo adalimumab biosimilar) antes de que el plan apruebe uno mas costoso como Skyrizi o Cosentyx.

paragraphs.en: Skyrizi and Stelara both require an intravenous induction dose for Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, administered in a hospital or infusion center under the buy-and-bill model. The facility purchases the drug, administers it, and bills Medicare Part B at ASP plus 6 percent, or bills a commercial payer at a separately negotiated facility rate. Commercial facility rates for the same IV dose can run several times the Medicare ASP because the chargemaster bundles drug acquisition cost with nursing time, IV supplies, infusion monitoring, and overhead allocations that have nothing to do with the drug itself.
paragraphs.es: Skyrizi y Stelara requieren una dosis de induccion intravenosa para la enfermedad de Crohn y la colitis ulcerosa, administrada en un hospital o centro de infusion bajo el modelo de compra y facturacion. La instalacion compra el medicamento, lo administra y factura a Medicare Parte B a ASP mas 6 por ciento, o factura a un pagador comercial a una tarifa de instalacion negociada por separado. Las tarifas comerciales de instalacion para la misma dosis IV pueden ser varias veces el ASP de Medicare.

paragraphs.en: Humira and Cosentyx are almost always self-administered by subcutaneous injection at home, so they rarely appear as inpatient hospital line items for plaque psoriasis. When either drug does appear on a hospital bill, usually because a patient was admitted for an unrelated reason and brought their own injection or the hospital dispensed a partial supply, the charge can run several times the outpatient retail rate because hospitals apply the same facility-rate markup logic used for infused drugs.
paragraphs.es: Humira y Cosentyx casi siempre se autoadministran por inyeccion subcutanea en casa, por lo que rara vez aparecen como elementos de linea hospitalaria interna para psoriasis en placas. Cuando cualquiera de los dos aparece en una factura hospitalaria, generalmente porque un paciente fue admitido por una razon no relacionada y llevo su propia inyeccion o el hospital dispenso un suministro parcial, el cargo puede ser varias veces la tarifa minorista ambulatoria.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part A stops paying for any of these four biologics the moment a patient is discharged, and coverage shifts to Part B for provider-administered IV doses or Part D for the outpatient self-injected prescription. That transition is where Stelara's 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day supply kicks in, along with standard Part D formulary-tier cost-sharing for Humira, Skyrizi, and Cosentyx. Patients discharged on a new biologic prescription without an active Part D plan or a manufacturer savings card active often face sticker shock at the outpatient specialty pharmacy because they assumed the inpatient rate would carry over.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte A deja de pagar cualquiera de estos cuatro biologicos en el momento en que el paciente es dado de alta, y la cobertura pasa a la Parte B para dosis IV administradas por proveedor o a la Parte D para la receta ambulatoria autoinyectada. Esa transicion es donde entra en vigor el Precio Justo Maximo IRA de Stelara de 2026 de $4,695 por suministro de 30 dias, junto con el costo compartido estandar del nivel de formulario de Parte D para Humira, Skyrizi y Cosentyx.

Most psoriasis patients self-inject at home under Part D and never see these codes, but they appear on bills for IV induction doses (Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis) or clinic-administered injections. note.en: Biosimilar status differs sharply across the four drugs. Humira (adalimumab) has more than 10 FDA-approved biosimilars as of 2026, seven with the interchangeable designation, following patent expiration in 2023. Stelara (ustekinumab) gained five biosimilars in 2025 (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Steqeyma, Yesintek, Pyzchiva) priced 80 to 92 percent below brand. Skyrizi (risankizumab-rzaa) has no biosimilar as of 2026, with core patent protection expected to last until approximately 2032. Cosentyx (secukinumab) also has no FDA-approved biosimilar as of 2026; its US substance patent is expected to expire in January 2029, with several biosimilar candidates (Celltrion, Samsung Bioepis, Bio-Thera) still in clinical development. None of the four drugs has a traditional small-molecule generic because all four are biologics regulated under the Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act (BPCIA) biosimilar pathway rather than the ANDA generic pathway.
note.es: El estado de biosimilar difiere notablemente entre los cuatro medicamentos. Humira (adalimumab) tiene mas de 10 biosimilares aprobados por la FDA a partir de 2026, siete con designacion intercambiable, tras la expiracion de la patente en 2023. Stelara (ustekinumab) obtuvo cinco biosimilares en 2025 (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Steqeyma, Yesintek, Pyzchiva) con precios entre 80 y 92 por ciento por debajo de la marca. Skyrizi (risankizumab-rzaa) no tiene biosimilar a partir de 2026, con proteccion de patente principal esperada hasta aproximadamente 2032. Cosentyx (secukinumab) tampoco tiene biosimilar aprobado por la FDA a partir de 2026; se espera que su patente de sustancia en EE.UU. expire en enero de 2029, con varios candidatos a biosimilar (Celltrion, Samsung Bioepis, Bio-Thera) aun en desarrollo clinico. Ninguno de los cuatro medicamentos tiene un generico tradicional de molecula pequena porque los cuatro son biologicos regulados bajo la via de biosimilares de la Ley de Competencia de Precios e Innovacion de Biologicos (BPCIA) en lugar de la via generica ANDA.

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Call 1-800-222-6885 or visit abbvieaccess.com/patient-assistance (Humira/Skyrizi), jjpaf.org (Stelara), or pap.novartis.com (Cosentyx) to confirm eligibility for your specific drug before completing paperwork. numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Llame al 1-800-222-6885 o visite abbvieaccess.com/patient-assistance (Humira/Skyrizi), jjpaf.org (Stelara), o pap.novartis.com (Cosentyx) para confirmar la elegibilidad de su medicamento especifico antes de completar el papeleo.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Download the patient application form from the manufacturer's website. Complete the patient section (name, address, household income, household size, insurance status) and have your prescriber complete and sign the prescriber section with a medical necessity attestation.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Descargue el formulario de solicitud del paciente desde el sitio web del fabricante. Complete la seccion del paciente y haga que su prescriptor complete y firme la seccion con una certificacion de necesidad medica.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Gather required documents: most recent federal tax return or 3 to 4 consecutive pay stubs showing household income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription for the specific biologic, and documentation showing no current prescription drug insurance covering that drug.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Submit the completed application and documents to the manufacturer's program by fax, mail, or online portal as listed on their website. Processing typically takes 7 to 15 business days depending on the manufacturer.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Envie la solicitud completa y los documentos al programa del fabricante por fax, correo o portal en linea. El procesamiento generalmente toma 7 a 15 dias habiles dependiendo del fabricante.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: If approved, the manufacturer ships the medication directly to your home or your prescriber's office at no charge. Enrollment is generally valid for 12 months; annual re-enrollment requires resubmitting income documentation and a new prescriber signature.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Si es aprobado, el fabricante envia el medicamento directamente a su domicilio o al consultorio de su prescriptor sin cargo. La inscripcion generalmente es valida por 12 meses; la reinscripcion anual requiere volver a presentar documentacion de ingresos.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part D treats these four psoriasis biologics very differently in 2026. Stelara is subject to the IRA Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day supply, applied at any network pharmacy regardless of which specific plan you carry. Humira, Skyrizi, and Cosentyx have no negotiated price; your out-of-pocket cost depends entirely on your Part D plan's formulary tier, and most plans place adalimumab biosimilars on a much lower tier with a smaller copay than brand Skyrizi or Cosentyx. All out-of-pocket spending on any of the four drugs counts toward the same 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100; once you hit that cap across all your Part D drugs combined, you pay $0 for the rest of the calendar year.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte D trata a estos cuatro biologicos para psoriasis de manera muy diferente en 2026. Stelara esta sujeto al Precio Justo Maximo IRA de $4,695 por suministro de 30 dias, aplicado en cualquier farmacia de la red sin importar el plan especifico que tenga. Humira, Skyrizi y Cosentyx no tienen un precio negociado; su costo de bolsillo depende completamente del nivel de formulario de su plan Parte D.

paragraphs.en: Extra Help (the Part D Low Income Subsidy) reduces cost-sharing further for Medicare beneficiaries with limited income and resources. In 2026, Extra Help enrollees pay $12.65 per fill for a brand-name biologic like Skyrizi or Cosentyx, and a smaller copay for a biosimilar such as adalimumab-adbm or Wezlana. Extra Help is generally available to beneficiaries with income at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level. Apply through the Social Security Administration at 1-800-772-1213 or at ssa.gov, and mention which specific biologic you take since eligibility rules for the manufacturer PAP on top of Extra Help vary by drug.
paragraphs.es: Extra Help (el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos de la Parte D) reduce aun mas el costo compartido para los beneficiarios de Medicare con ingresos y recursos limitados. En 2026, los inscritos en Extra Help pagan $12.65 por reposicion para un biologico de marca como Skyrizi o Cosentyx, y un copago menor para un biosimilar como adalimumab-adbm o Wezlana.

intro.en: These four biologics span both Part B (IV/infusion for Skyrizi and Stelara) and Part D (subcutaneous self-injection for all four), so billing errors often involve the wrong benefit or the wrong J-code. Watch for these issues on your Explanation of Benefits or itemized bill:
intro.es: Estos cuatro biologicos abarcan tanto la Parte B (IV/infusion para Skyrizi y Stelara) como la Parte D (autoinyeccion subcutanea para los cuatro), por lo que los errores de facturacion a menudo involucran el beneficio incorrecto o el codigo J incorrecto. Verifique estos problemas en su Explicacion de Beneficios o factura detallada:

items.en: Wrong J-code: J3357 (Stelara subcutaneous) used for an IV infusion, or J3358 (Stelara IV) used for a self-administered subcutaneous dose. The same mix-up can occur between J2327 (Skyrizi IV) and a subcutaneous Skyrizi maintenance dose billed under Part D pharmacy benefits instead.
items.es: Codigo J incorrecto: J3357 (Stelara subcutaneo) utilizado para una infusion IV, o J3358 (Stelara IV) utilizado para una dosis subcutanea autoadministrada. La misma confusion puede ocurrir entre J2327 (Skyrizi IV) y una dosis de mantenimiento subcutanea de Skyrizi facturada bajo los beneficios de farmacia de la Parte D.

items.en: Pharmacy charges more than the $4,695 Stelara IRA Maximum Fair Price for a Medicare Part D fill in 2026, which violates federal law; ask your plan's member services to reprocess the claim.
items.es: La farmacia cobra mas del Precio Justo Maximo IRA de $4,695 de Stelara en una reposicion de Medicare Parte D en 2026, lo que viola la ley federal; pida al servicio de miembros de su plan que reprocese el reclamo.

items.en: Biosimilar substituted but billed as brand: your EOB shows Humira or Stelara brand charges but the pharmacy dispensed a biosimilar like Cyltezo, Hyrimoz, or Wezlana. The biosimilar should be billed at its own ASP or list rate, which differs from the brand rate.
items.es: Biosimilar sustituido pero facturado como marca: su EOB muestra cargos de la marca Humira o Stelara pero la farmacia dispenso un biosimilar como Cyltezo, Hyrimoz o Wezlana. El biosimilar debe facturarse a su propia tarifa ASP o de lista, diferente de la tarifa de marca.

items.en: Manufacturer savings card applied for a patient who has Medicare or Medicaid, which is prohibited and can result in a claim clawback later.
items.es: Tarjeta de ahorro del fabricante aplicada a un paciente que tiene Medicare o Medicaid, lo cual esta prohibido y puede resultar en una recuperacion del reclamo mas tarde.

items.en: Step therapy denial requiring a trial of biosimilar adalimumab or another lower-cost biologic first, without documenting that the required first-step drug was already tried and failed or is clinically inappropriate.
items.es: Denegacion de terapia escalonada que requiere una prueba de adalimumab biosimilar u otro biologico de menor costo primero, sin documentar que el medicamento de primer paso ya se probo y fallo o es clinicamente inapropiado.

items.en: Charged the standard copay after you already hit the $2,100 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap for the year across all your combined Part D drugs.
items.es: Se le cobro el copago estandar despues de que ya alcanzo el limite anual de bolsillo de la Parte D de $2,100 para el ano entre todos sus medicamentos combinados de Parte D.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice from your insurer or Part D plan. Federal law requires written notice within 72 hours for standard decisions, or 24 hours for expedited (urgent) requests, stating the specific reason for denial and your appeal rights.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito de su aseguradora o plan Parte D. La ley federal requiere aviso escrito dentro de las 72 horas para decisiones estandar, o 24 horas para solicitudes urgentes.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: File a formal appeal within 60 days of the written denial. Include a prescriber letter documenting medical necessity, prior treatment history, and why the plan's preferred alternative is not clinically appropriate for your condition.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias del aviso de denegacion por escrito. Incluya una carta del prescriptor que documente la necesidad medica y el historial de tratamiento previo.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: Ask your prescriber to request a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director, documenting why biosimilar adalimumab or another required step-therapy drug is contraindicated, already failed, or carries specific risks given your disease severity.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Solicite a su prescriptor que pida una revision medico a medico con el director medico del plan, documentando por que el adalimumab biosimilar u otro medicamento de terapia escalonada requerido esta contraindicado o ya fallo.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: If the internal appeal is denied, escalate to an Independent Review Entity for Medicare Part D plans at 1-800-633-4227, or to your state Department of Insurance for commercial plans. Medicare beneficiaries can also contact their State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) for free counseling.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Si la apelacion interna es denegada, escale a una Entidad de Revision Independiente para planes Medicare Parte D al 1-800-633-4227, o al Departamento de Seguros de su estado para planes comerciales.

stepTherapyOverride.en: If your plan requires step therapy (trying biosimilar adalimumab or a cheaper biologic before Skyrizi or Cosentyx), your prescriber can file a step-therapy exception by documenting that the required first-step drug is medically contraindicated, was already tried and failed (inadequate response, adverse events, or intolerance), or that requiring it would cause serious harm given your disease severity, such as extensive body surface area involvement or active psoriatic arthritis joint damage. Medicare and most state laws require plans to decide on a step-therapy exception within 72 hours of complete documentation, or 24 hours for urgent cases.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada (probar adalimumab biosimilar u otro biologico mas economico antes de Skyrizi o Cosentyx), su prescriptor puede presentar una excepcion de terapia escalonada documentando que el medicamento de primer paso requerido esta medicamente contraindicado, ya se probo y fallo, o que requerirlo causaria dano grave dada la severidad de su enfermedad.

papFallback.en: If all insurance appeals fail, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific biologic: myAbbVie Assist (abbvieaccess.com) for Humira or Skyrizi, JJPAF (jjpaf.org) for Stelara, or the Novartis Patient Assistance Foundation (pap.novartis.com) for Cosentyx. Each has a different FPL threshold, so check the one that applies to your prescribed drug before assuming you do not qualify.
papFallback.es: Si todas las apelaciones de seguro fallan, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su biologico especifico: myAbbVie Assist (abbvieaccess.com) para Humira o Skyrizi, JJPAF (jjpaf.org) para Stelara, o la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Novartis (pap.novartis.com) para Cosentyx.

genericAlternative.en: Biosimilar adalimumab (Humira) is the most complete lower-cost alternative among the four, at $550 to $1,315 per month depending on the specific biosimilar. Biosimilar ustekinumab (Stelara), including Wezlana, Selarsdi, and Yesintek, runs 80 to 92 percent below brand Stelara. No biosimilar exists for Skyrizi or Cosentyx as of 2026. Discuss any substitution with your dermatologist or rheumatologist before switching, since not all biosimilars carry the FDA's interchangeable designation and disease response can vary between patients.
genericAlternative.es: El adalimumab biosimilar (Humira) es la alternativa de menor costo mas completa entre los cuatro, a $550 a $1,315 por mes dependiendo del biosimilar especifico. El ustekinumab biosimilar (Stelara), incluyendo Wezlana, Selarsdi y Yesintek, cuesta entre 80 y 92 por ciento menos que la marca Stelara. Ningun biosimilar existe para Skyrizi o Cosentyx a partir de 2026.

en.question: Is there a generic or biosimilar for Humira, Skyrizi, Stelara, or Cosentyx?
en.answer: Yes for two of the four. Humira has more than 10 FDA-approved adalimumab biosimilars as of 2026, priced as low as $550 per month. Stelara has five ustekinumab biosimilars (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Steqeyma, Yesintek, Pyzchiva) that launched in 2025, priced 80 to 92 percent below brand. Skyrizi has no biosimilar and is expected to remain patent-protected until approximately 2032. Cosentyx also has no biosimilar as of 2026; its US patent is expected to expire in January 2029.

en.question: How do I apply for a psoriasis biologic patient assistance program?
en.answer: Apply to the manufacturer of your specific drug: myAbbVie Assist at abbvieaccess.com for Humira or Skyrizi, JJPAF at jjpaf.org for Stelara, or the Novartis Patient Assistance Foundation at pap.novartis.com for Cosentyx. Each requires proof of income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription, and documentation that you have no prescription drug coverage for that drug. Processing takes 7 to 15 business days, and approved patients typically receive a 12-month supply that requires annual re-enrollment.

en.question: Can I use a manufacturer savings card with Medicare for these biologics?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback law (42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b) bars Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and VA beneficiaries from using any manufacturer copay savings card, including HUMIRA Complete, Skyrizi Complete, Cosentyx Connect, and Janssen CarePath. Medicare Part D patients on Stelara should instead rely on the 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Price of $4,695, and patients on Humira, Skyrizi, or Cosentyx should apply for Part D Extra Help or the matching manufacturer PAP.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage or requires step therapy before approving my biologic?
en.answer: Request a written denial notice, then file a formal appeal within 60 days with a prescriber letter documenting medical necessity. If your plan requires step therapy with biosimilar adalimumab or a cheaper biologic first, your prescriber can file a step-therapy exception documenting contraindication, prior treatment failure, or disease severity. If the appeal fails, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific drug as a fallback.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated Medicare price apply to all four psoriasis biologics?
en.answer: No, it applies to only one of the four. Stelara was selected for Medicare's first round of Inflation Reduction Act negotiation, with a Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 per 30-day supply effective January 1, 2026. Humira was not selected because biosimilar competition already existed before CMS finalized Round 1 in 2023. Skyrizi and Cosentyx were not selected for either the 2026 or 2027 negotiation rounds, so their Part D cost depends on your plan's formulary tier rather than a government-negotiated price.

en.question: What does each biologic cost without insurance at the pharmacy counter in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance, monthly-equivalent brand cash prices run about $3,971 to $6,137 for Stelara, $6,922 for Humira brand, $7,083 to $8,750 for Skyrizi, and $7,189 to $8,492 for Cosentyx. Humira's biosimilar competition changes the picture dramatically: unbranded adalimumab-adbm costs as little as $550 per month with a GoodRx coupon, far below any of the other three drugs.

en.question: Do I qualify for a patient assistance program based on my income?
en.answer: It depends on which drug you take, since each manufacturer sets a different income cutoff. myAbbVie Assist for Humira and Skyrizi generally requires household income at or below 600% of the Federal Poverty Level ($95,760 for one person in 2026). JJPAF for Stelara and the Novartis Patient Assistance Foundation for Cosentyx both use roughly 500% FPL. Check the specific program for your prescribed drug rather than assuming one threshold applies to all four.

en.question: Which psoriasis biologic is cheapest: Humira, Skyrizi, Stelara, or Cosentyx?
en.answer: For uninsured patients without a manufacturer PAP, biosimilar adalimumab (Humira) is by far the cheapest at $550 to $1,315 per month, since it has the most mature biosimilar market of the four. For Medicare Part D patients, Stelara is often cheapest in practice because its 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Price of $4,695 is capped by law regardless of formulary tier, while Skyrizi and Cosentyx cost depends entirely on your plan's formulary placement and prior authorization approval.

es.question: Hay un generico o biosimilar para Humira, Skyrizi, Stelara o Cosentyx?
es.answer: Si para dos de los cuatro. Humira tiene mas de 10 biosimilares de adalimumab aprobados por la FDA a partir de 2026, con precios desde $550 por mes. Stelara tiene cinco biosimilares de ustekinumab (Wezlana, Selarsdi, Steqeyma, Yesintek, Pyzchiva) lanzados en 2025, con precios 80 a 92 por ciento por debajo de la marca. Skyrizi no tiene biosimilar y se espera que permanezca protegido por patente hasta aproximadamente 2032. Cosentyx tampoco tiene biosimilar a partir de 2026; se espera que su patente en EE.UU. expire en enero de 2029.

es.question: Como solicito un programa de asistencia al paciente para un biologico de psoriasis?
es.answer: Solicite al fabricante de su medicamento especifico: myAbbVie Assist en abbvieaccess.com para Humira o Skyrizi, JJPAF en jjpaf.org para Stelara, o la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Novartis en pap.novartis.com para Cosentyx. Cada uno requiere comprobante de ingresos, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y documentacion de que no tiene cobertura de medicamentos para ese medicamento. El procesamiento toma 7 a 15 dias habiles.

es.question: Puedo usar una tarjeta de ahorro del fabricante con Medicare para estos biologicos?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b) prohibe a los beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE y VA usar cualquier tarjeta de ahorro de copago del fabricante, incluyendo HUMIRA Complete, Skyrizi Complete, Cosentyx Connect y Janssen CarePath. Los pacientes de Medicare Parte D con Stelara deben confiar en el Precio Justo Maximo IRA de 2026 de $4,695, y los pacientes con Humira, Skyrizi o Cosentyx deben solicitar la Ayuda Adicional de Parte D o el PAP del fabricante correspondiente.

es.question: Que hago si mi seguro deniega la cobertura o requiere terapia escalonada antes de aprobar mi biologico?
es.answer: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito, luego presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias con una carta del prescriptor que documente la necesidad medica. Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada con adalimumab biosimilar u otro biologico mas economico primero, su prescriptor puede presentar una excepcion documentando contraindicacion, fallo previo o severidad de la enfermedad. Si la apelacion falla, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su medicamento especifico.

es.question: El precio negociado de la IRA de Medicare aplica a los cuatro biologicos de psoriasis?
es.answer: No, aplica solo a uno de los cuatro. Stelara fue seleccionado para la primera ronda de negociacion de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, con un Precio Justo Maximo de $4,695 por suministro de 30 dias efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026. Humira no fue seleccionado porque ya existia competencia biosimilar antes de que CMS finalizara la Ronda 1 en 2023. Skyrizi y Cosentyx no fueron seleccionados para las rondas de negociacion de 2026 ni 2027.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta cada biologico sin seguro en la farmacia en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro, los precios de marca en efectivo mensuales equivalentes son aproximadamente $3,971 a $6,137 para Stelara, $6,922 para Humira de marca, $7,083 a $8,750 para Skyrizi y $7,189 a $8,492 para Cosentyx. La competencia biosimilar de Humira cambia drasticamente el panorama: el adalimumab-adbm sin marca cuesta tan solo $550 por mes con un cupon de GoodRx, muy por debajo de cualquiera de los otros tres medicamentos.

es.question: Califico para un programa de asistencia al paciente segun mis ingresos?
es.answer: Depende de que medicamento tome, ya que cada fabricante establece un limite de ingresos diferente. myAbbVie Assist para Humira y Skyrizi generalmente requiere ingresos familiares en o por debajo del 600% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($95,760 para una persona en 2026). JJPAF para Stelara y la Fundacion de Asistencia al Paciente de Novartis para Cosentyx usan aproximadamente el 500% FPL.

es.question: Cual biologico para psoriasis es mas barato: Humira, Skyrizi, Stelara o Cosentyx?
es.answer: Para pacientes sin seguro y sin un PAP del fabricante, el adalimumab biosimilar (Humira) es por mucho el mas barato a $550 a $1,315 por mes, ya que tiene el mercado biosimilar mas maduro de los cuatro. Para pacientes de Medicare Parte D, Stelara suele ser el mas barato en la practica porque su Precio Justo Maximo IRA 2026 de $4,695 esta limitado por ley sin importar el nivel de formulario.
